title: Re-render a component in NuxtJS when SSR is used / introduce controlled mode
body:
**Feature / InstantSearch V4 ⚡️**

### What is your use case for such a feature?

Being able to re-render the view explicitly when a query param changes in the URL.
We see updated data coming from API but the view doesn’t re-render no matter what.
We tried with instantsearch.hydrate(this.algoliaState) without any result. 
It seems that this is working only for the very first rendering of the component. ([From Carespot](https://discourse.algolia.com/t/re-render-a-component-in-nuxtjs-when-ssr-is-used/9694))

### What is your proposal
Upgrade vue-instantsearch to use instantsearch v4
https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4362

> Introducing a controlled mode in InstantSearch allows more powerful state updates coming from internal events and one-time external events.

### What is the version you are using?

v2.7.0
